resources.string: Tap a format, then drag to frame it · double-tap to center
On this phone the frames stay centered so the second camera is in every video
Lock white balance (no colour shifts mid-shot)
Front and back cameras together. Pick a corner for the second camera; ⟳ swaps which one is big.
This phone can\'t use the front and back cameras at the same time.
Stabilization isn\'t available with this camera.
%1$d fps isn\'t possible with these settings, recording at the standard rate.
HLG 10-bit isn\'t available on this camera with these settings.
DF-Log needs custom tone curves, which this camera doesn\'t allow.
Recording starts %1$d s after you press record
Night: the camera brightens dark scenes (may lower the frame rate)
Night needs automatic exposure. Set shutter and ISO to Auto first.
Monitoring aids are only drawn on screen, never recorded. Long-press the picture to lock exposure and focus.
Zebras, peaking and false colour aren\'t available in Front + Back or HLG HDR.
Apply LUT to videos and photos (off = view only)
That file isn\'t a usable 3D LUT: %1$s
Live LUT preview isn\'t available on this phone. The look is still applied to your videos.
While cut videos stay 10-bit HDR, LUTs aren\'t applied (they\'re made for standard range). Turn off “Keep cut videos 10-bit HDR” under Profile to bake a LUT.
The look is applied to your videos (no live preview in this mode).
DualFrame needs the camera to record, and the microphone for sound.
Keep DualFrame open until this finishes.
Your original recording was saved to Movies › DualFrame, so nothing is lost.

Nothing here yet.
Your videos will appear here after you record.

Videos made before a reinstall are in your Photos app, under Movies/DualFrame.
It will be removed from your phone.
This camera can\'t record %1$d fps slow motion, so a slower speed it supports is used.
In 120 / 240 fps slow motion the camera sets exposure, focus and colour itself. Manual controls come back at normal speed.
Slow motion is on, so the camera runs at %1$d fps.
Locking a lens stops the phone switching lenses as you zoom, so the picture never jumps mid-shot. Zoom then stays within that lens.
This phone gives apps one lens on this side. Zoom still works within it.
Lens locking isn\'t available in Front + Back.
This phone lists that lens but won\'t let apps use it on its own, so it\'s back to Auto.
Your 9:16, 16:9… videos stay 10-bit HLG (HEVC) for grading. Phones that can\'t save edited HDR fall back to standard range automatically.
Cut videos are converted to standard range, ready to post. The 10-bit original is kept.
Save DF-Log → Rec.709 LUT for your editor
Saved DF-Log_to_Rec709.cube to Downloads. Use it as the input LUT in Resolve, Premiere, Final Cut or LumaFusion.
Couldn\'t save the LUT to Downloads.
This phone\'s camera stops when given DF-Log\'s tone curve, so DF-Log is off for now. Use HLG 10-bit for grading instead.
Photos use one camera, so Front + Back is paused in Photo mode.
Your phone ignored the DF-Log curve (its camera kept its own tone processing), so DF-Log is off. Use HLG 10-bit for a flat, wide-range picture.
DF-Log looks flat and grey on purpose: that\'s the extra highlight and shadow detail for grading. Pick Rec.709 under LUT to view it normally while you shoot.
With Log, LUTs are usually for viewing only, so the files stay flat for grading. Turn on “Apply LUT to videos” to bake the look in.
Film rates (23.98 / 29.97 / 59.94) need manual exposure control, which this camera doesn\'t allow.
Film rates run the shutter at 180° automatically and adjust ISO, unless you set them yourself.
Follow me: frames follow your face
Follow me on: the frames follow the main face, in the preview and in your videos.
Follow me off: frames stay where you put them.
This camera setup can\'t run face tracking alongside recording, so Follow me is paused. Try a lower resolution or turn off stabilization.
Captions need Android 13+ with on-device speech recognition, which this phone doesn\'t have.
Downloading Android\'s free %1$s speech pack for captions. It finishes in the background.
This phone\'s speech engine doesn\'t offer %1$s on the device.
Cuts out every pause longer than the length you pick, leaving a breath either side so words aren\'t clipped. Quiet is judged against each clip\'s own background noise.
%1$d clip(s) · %2$s in total. The preview plays exactly what will be saved.
%1$s in total · %2$s of silence removed. The preview plays exactly what will be saved.
Saved to your library. The originals are unchanged.
Tap any word to fix it or give it its own colour, size or effect. Done makes your videos with these captions; ✕ keeps them as recognized.
What language is spoken? Captions are made on the phone, free.
No speech recognized. If the speech pack is still downloading, try again in a minute.
Type to correct. A space splits it into words; clear it to remove the word.
Saved a captioned copy to your library. The original is unchanged.
